answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. This holds because each vote is weighted by a track record that only grows through honest participation, turning a Sybil flood into short-lived, low-weight votes. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort. Consider a saffron as the anchor of the cost.
